work_handoff.title: Opening P03-B Task and P04-C Hints — Two Candidate PNGs, Same P03-A Blood Door
requirements: READ delivery_manifest.json and this WORK_HANDOFF.md from the verified GitHub Actions Artifact; re-check every reference binary SHA256/byte size and PNG dimensions before generation. If any mismatch, STOP and report, no renders.

Produce precisely TWO 941x1672 9:16 PNG candidate images, names OPENING_P03B_TASK_MAIN_CANDIDATE_01.png and OPENING_P04C_HINTS_MAIN_CANDIDATE_01.png. These are image numbers 2 and 3 of PO-authorized three-shot Opening V0.3 sequence; P03-A is already PO Approved and MUST NOT be regenerated.

Use P03-A controlled reference as the *SAME EXACT* ghost-house third-floor closed WOODEN BLOOD DOOR. Keep door shape, panel arrangement, wood grain, doorframe, hardware, surrounding dim room, color, light direction and blood-letter material continuous. Zoom/crop/reframe from same scene rather than inventing a new door.

Location is GHOST HOUSE THIRD FLOOR (诡舍三楼), NOT Monica Manor gate, NOT Allen Castle entry. The door is fully CLOSED. Never depict currently raining conditions, ownership of found exit key, or a figure identifying 'it'.

P03-B: a closer view of the same real closed wood door; make the two main mission conditions visually readable and accurate Chinese: 【任务：在莫妮卡夫人的庄园中活过五日并找到离开庄园的大门钥匙】. Show this on the real door surface, naturally blood-stained and material-integrated, never as independent card/overlay/UI. Emphasize '活过五日' and '离开庄园的大门钥匙' within the actual door lettering; do not replace estate exit gate with Castle entrance or ghost-house door.

P04-C: a complementary closer view of the SAME door at a coherent near-angle/scene geometry; show both danger hints exactly, legibly and distinctly: 【提示1：不要淋雨】; 【提示2：不要长时间和它对视】. Keep the referent of '它' unresolved. This shot may reduce characters to edge silhouettes or a very restrained gaze reaction but MUST NOT block rules.

The fully approved P03-A scene may already contain blood writing. It is a texture/style reference, NOT proof that its text is correctly transcribed. Independently ensure all specified newly readable Chinese is exact (by controlled typography/compositing if needed). Check line-by-line; text fidelity must not depend on generative glyph approximation.

Do not reconstruct unrelated parts of the scene or generate entirely different doors. For compositing, preserve original door pixels outside the constrained local lettering zone wherever achievable; any necessary lighting/text edits must stay local and preserve the same grain, panel seams, and door geometry. Do not use a reverse text-removal process on old Blood Door Candidate 01.

For person-visible areas use the delivered Ning Qiushui and Jun Luyuan Approved identity sheets/face refs, no new cast, no appearance drift or posed frontal portraits. Characters are subordinate to readable blood-written content.

Perform internal QC on final 2 PNGs: 941x1672 PNG signatures, text accurate character-by-character, natural blood texture, same-door continuity, no unapproved story facts. If a shot fails text/continuity QC, stop and report the candidate limitation rather than falsely calling it Approved.

Deliver the two candidate images for Product Owner visual review, including exact filenames, preview and storage links if actually uploaded; mark both CANDIDATE, NOT APPROVED. Stop immediately after these two images are produced; do not create alternative versions.

Do not alter P03-A approved PNG, Story Shot Index, production video index, original Opening V001, PO-approved 40.260s audio, or Blood Door independent A/B task. No video animation, soundtrack manipulation, GitHub main merge or formal story-shot registration.
exclusions: No extra fourth image, no redo P03-A, no separate door scene reference graphic
No regeneration of entire door geometry, no independent gate/wood design
